description: No schedule, one PR at a time, merged by GitHub auto-merge once the CI `build` check passes

packageRules.description: Follow serversideup's release tags for PHP 8.5 FrankenPHP on Alpine (8.5-frankenphp-alpine-v5.0.2 to -v5.0.3); betas and the per-PHP-patch tags don't match and are ignored. The digest update catches rebuilds of the same tag.
A new serversideup major release can rename settings or change its Caddyfile: open the PR but merge it by hand
